Property Tax
Pay Property Taxes
Property taxes may be paid online or at the Ward County Auditor / Treasurer’s Office.
Pay Property Taxes Online
→ Pay Property Taxes
Online payment options include:
Credit or Debit Card — Service fee of 2.65% , with a minimum fee of $3
ACH / eCheck — Service fee of $1.50
Digital Wallet — Available through the online payment system
Service fees are charged by the payment processor and are separate from the property tax amount.
Property Tax Information
Property tax information, including current and prior-year taxes, may be viewed online.
View Ward County Property Tax Information
→ WARD COUNTY PROPERTY TAX
Tax Statements
Real estate tax statements are mailed each December. Mobile home tax statements are also mailed in December.
Failure to receive a tax statement does not relieve the property owner of responsibility for payment or extend applicable deadlines. Property owners are responsible for notifying the Ward County Auditor / Treasurer’s Office of address changes.
Payment Due Dates
A 5% discount is allowed on consolidated real estate and mobile home taxes when paid or postmarked on or before February 15 .
For real estate taxes , the first installment and the full amount of yearly special assessments are due by March 1 . The second installment is due by October 15 .
For mobile home taxes , the first installment is due by March 1 and the second installment is due by June 30 .
Receipts are mailed only upon request.
No refund is issued when an overpayment is $5 or less .
View the Penalty Schedule
→ Penalty Schedule
Delinquent Real Estate Taxes & Foreclosure
Real estate taxes that remain unpaid may eventually become subject to the tax foreclosure process.
For information regarding the tax foreclosure process, redemption deadlines, the annual tax foreclosure auction, and properties available for sale, visit the Tax Foreclosure Properties page.
Mobile Home Taxes
Mobile home taxes that are not paid by October 15 may be subject to additional sheriff's costs. If the taxes remain unpaid, the Sheriff's Office may take possession of the mobile home and conduct a sale.

Download the Mill Levy Worksheet
→ 2025 Levy Sheet Final
For questions regarding property taxes or payments, contact the Ward County Auditor / Treasurer’s Office at 701-857-6420.
